first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining now, making simplification the most directly aligned intervention. I will verify the two archived onboarding/signup records because they are highly consequential to the immediate experiment and their durability and revenue-quality implications need confirmation. A small guarded test limits the risk that easier completion increases low-quality or poorly qualified accounts rather than sustainable revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding, focused on SMB self-serve accounts where the evidence applies. The intervention directly addresses both current declines: onboarding completion and activation. Shortened onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, while signup simplification lifted SMB activation and qualified revenue. Monitor qualified revenue and retention as guardrails because signup simplification also showed a 1% retention decline and has not been validated beyond SMB.
